```{r}
library(R.matlab)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# temporary workaround for bug001
root_dir <- "~/github/ada/"
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/github/ada/")
```


## Data review

-   `bins`: binned neural recordings, $4600 \times 100 \times 96$, or samples times binned sums times channels
-   `file.names`: (unsure) an empty string
-   `run.names`: (unsure) broken references to the raw data
-   `incl.subj`: subject ID
-   `save.label`: the stimulus labels
-   `session.label`: experimental details

In `session.label`, columns are:

1. dummy indexing, 
2. area recorded, 
3. age at recording (weeks), and
4. number of repeats per stimulus. 

## Constants

```{r}
t2_dir <- "data/raw/lee2024/data/textures2_data/"
```

## Helper functions

These functions assume that the input data `x` is the loaded MATLAB file. 

```{r}
source("~/github/ada/R/preprocessing.R")
```

## Example data

```{r}
# bug001
# t2_v1 <- R.matlab::readMat(paste0(t2_dir, "zz_FC_Textures2_20wk_4reps_1subj.mat"))
t2_v1 <- R.matlab::readMat(paste0(root_dir, t2_dir, "zz_FC_Textures2_20wk_4reps_1subj.mat"))
stims <- clean_stimuli(t2_v1)
firings <- t2_v1$bins

onset_time <- onset_session(
  firings, list(stims$coherence > 0, stims$coherence == 0)
)
times <- onset_time:(onset_time + 14)

# Get responsive channels
rep_split <- odd_even_reps(stims)
responsive <- find_channels(firings, rep_split, stims$famsamp, times)
```

### Between-family summary

```{r}
blanks <- stims$coherence == 0
noise  <- stims$coherence == 1
struct <- stims$coherence == 2

flat_nochannel <- apply(firings[, , ], c(1, 2), sum, na.rm = T)
```

```{r}
grp_df <- stims %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(coherence, family) %>%
  group_by(coherence, family) %>%
  mutate(grp = cur_group_id())

grp_ <- unique(grp_df)

family_all_mat <- grouped_rowsums(flat_nochannel, grp_df$grp)
family_all <- family_all_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(grp = unique(grp_df$grp)) %>%
  tidyr::gather("time", "firing", -grp) %>%
  mutate(time = as.integer(gsub("V", "", time))) %>%
  left_join(grp_, by = "grp") %>%
  mutate(family = as.factor(family))
```

```{r}
family_all %>%
  filter(coherence == 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = firing, color = family)) +
    geom_line()
```

```{r}
family_all %>%
  filter(coherence == 1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = firing, color = family)) +
    geom_line()
```

```{r}
family_all %>%
  filter(coherence == 2) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = firing, color = family)) +
    geom_line()
```

```{r}
family_all %>%
  filter(coherence == 2) %>%
  filter(time %in% times) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = firing, color = family)) +
    geom_line()
```
